mapper.select: SELECT product_id FROM oms_cart_item WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_status = 0 AND quantity > 0 GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY MAX(id) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT i.product_id FROM oms_order_item i JOIN oms_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.delete_status = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY i.product_id ORDER BY MAX(o.id) DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT b.* FROM sms_home_brand hb LEFT JOIN pms_brand b ON hb.brand_id = b.id WHERE hb.recommend_status = 1 AND b.show_status = 1 ORDER BY hb.sort DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT pr.flash_promotion_price, pr.flash_promotion_count, pr.flash_promotion_limit, p.* FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation pr LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE pr.flash_promotion_id = #{flashPromotionId} AND pr.flash_promotion_session_id = #{sessionId} AND p.publish_status = 1 AND p.delete_status = 0

SELECT p.* FROM sms_home_new_product hp LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON hp.product_id = p.id WHERE hp.recommend_status = 1 AND p.publish_status = 1 AND p.delete_status = 0 ORDER BY hp.sort DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit};

SELECT p.* FROM sms_home_recommend_product hp LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON hp.product_id = p.id WHERE hp.recommend_status = 1 AND p.publish_status = 1 AND p.delete_status = 0 ORDER BY hp.sort DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit};
SELECT s.* FROM sms_home_recommend_subject hs LEFT JOIN cms_subject s ON hs.subject_id = s.id WHERE hs.recommend_status = 1 AND s.show_status = 1 ORDER BY hs.sort DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit};
